tagline: Making homeownership simpler, faster, and fairer for everyone
hero_kpi_rationale: The volume of homes sold is the primary indicator of operational traction and scalability of the iBuying model, which relies on the ability to quickly buy and resell properties through a technology platform.

kpis.name: Homes Sold
kpis.explanation: Total number of homes sold by Opendoor during the year.
kpis.description: In 2025, Opendoor sold over 11,700 homes, demonstrating the growth of its iBuying model at a national scale.
kpis.signal: High volume of digital real estate transactions

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from home sales and real estate services.
kpis.description: Opendoor generated $4.371 billion in revenue in 2025 (vs $5.153 billion in 2024), impacted by a strategic reduction in real estate inventory.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline reflecting reduction in real estate inventory

kpis.name: Net Promoter Score (NPS)
kpis.explanation: Customer satisfaction metric based on the likelihood of Opendoor being recommended by its seller customers.
kpis.description: Opendoor has maintained an average NPS of nearly 80 since 2021, reflecting a highly positive customer experience and seller trust in the platform.
kpis.signal: Consistently high customer satisfaction since launch

kpis.name: Net Real Estate Inventory
kpis.explanation: Book value of homes held in inventory awaiting sale, adjusted to net realizable value.
kpis.description: Net real estate inventory decreased from $2.159 billion in 2024 to $0.925 billion in 2025, indicating accelerated sales or a strategic inventory drawdown.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in real estate inventory due to accelerated sales or strategic divestment

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total book value of assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Total assets declined from $3.126 billion in 2024 to $2.407 billion in 2025, reflecting a balance sheet contraction related to inventory management.
kpis.signal: Significant balance sheet reduction reflecting lower real estate inventory and associated assets

kpis.name: Shareholders' Equity
kpis.explanation: Difference between company assets and liabilities, representing net value for shareholders.
kpis.description: Shareholders' equity increased from $0.713 billion to $1.005 billion between 2024 and 2025, a 40.8% improvement, reflecting a stronger balance sheet structure.
kpis.signal: Notable improvement in equity reflecting reduced liabilities

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant cybersecurity risks related to the collection and storage of sensitive customer data. The 10-K details a formal governance structure with an Audit and Risk Committee overseeing the cybersecurity risk management program.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The real estate technology and iBuying market remains competitive with several players offering similar services. Opendoor must maintain its technological and service differentiation.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a sector subject to complex federal and state real estate regulations. Regulatory changes could impact operations.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks inherent in its real estate transaction and customer data processing activities.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company is not directly exposed to geopolitical risks but operates exclusively in the United States. Geopolitical events could indirectly affect the U.S. housing market.

risks.title: Technology
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology for its operational model (AI, data science, digital platform). Rapid technological change requires continuous R&D investment.

risks.title: Real Estate Market Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Opendoor's model is highly dependent on conditions in the U.S. residential real estate market, federal interest rates, and market liquidity.

ai_positioning.summary: Opendoor explicitly highlights artificial intelligence, data science, and purpose-built software as key differentiators of its platform. AI is presented as a core component of the operational model for pricing and resale price forecasting.
evidence: By leveraging artificial intelligence, data science and purpose-built software, we enable consumers to transact directly with Opendoor
Powered by artificial intelligence and advanced technology, we are building a real estate platform
